lines.item: Hotel - Fairfield Inn & Suites Manhattan/Central Park, King Room, 7 nights (Booking-line estimate)
lines.note: $985.60 before taxes x 1.1475 + 7 x $4 Booking.com City tax = $1,158.98. NYC Finance ($2/night) plus NYS unit fee ($1.50/night) yields $1,155.48 instead; the $0.50/night difference is unresolved (F-04). Neither is a checkout quote.

lines.item: Flights - 2 adults, AMS to JFK return, 15-22 Feb 2027 (the itinerary's own dates)
lines.note: Out on 15 Feb, back on 22 Feb: Aer Lingus 1-stop round trip $606 per adult, nonstop KLM/Delta $904-906, and the absolute cheapest $562 with a 6h20m Dublin layover. The line uses the $606 itinerary x 2. Google Flights prices 1 adult, so two seats may not cost exactly double (F-15).

lines.item: Transit - 2 adults, 7 days, MTA fare cap
lines.note: MTA caps subway and local bus spend at $35 per person per 7-day period with tap-and-ride. 2 x $35 is the maximum, not an estimate.

lines.item: American Museum of Natural History - 2 adults, standard General Admission
lines.note: $37 standard adult General Admission x 2. Paid ticketed exhibitions are extra; New York State residents may pay what they wish for General Admission only.

lines.item: 9/11 Memorial & Museum - 2 adults (top of the official range)
Top of the Rock - 2 adults (official 'from' price)
Dinner at Le Bernardin - Chef's Tasting for 2, food only
lines.note: $350 per person. With the wine pairing ($530 pp) the same meal is $1,060 for two.

lines.item: Dinner at Gabriel Kreuther - Chef's Tasting for 2, food only
lines.note: $325 per person. Wine pairing from $255 pp is extra.

lines.item: Breakfast, lunches and non-MICHELIN dinners - 7 days, 2 adults
lines.note: No official source exists for what a couple spends on ordinary meals. Inventing a daily allowance would be a guess, so this line is blank.

budget.priced_subtotal_note: Sum of all budget lines with a read or formula price. This priced subtotal includes a derived hotel fee calculation and a one-adult fare doubled for two; it is not a complete trip budget.

days.plan: Land at JFK, check in. Evening walk to Times Square / Rockefeller Center. No timed booking on arrival day.
MoMA in the morning (opens 10:30). Top of the Rock timed entry late afternoon for daylight and dusk.
American Museum of Natural History (daily 10:00-17:30), then Central Park. The Met is closed on Wednesdays.
9/11 Memorial & Museum (open Wed-Mon). Keep the Statue of Liberty ferry optional: the February 2027 sailing schedule and an end-to-end journey time were not verified.
High Line and Chelsea Market by day. Le Bernardin Chef's Tasting at 17:00 or later.
Brooklyn Bridge walkway early, then DUMBO. Gabriel Kreuther for dinner in Midtown.
The Met (Sunday hours 10:00-17:00) if energy and timing allow, or keep the day as a weather-dependent buffer. Le Bernardin is closed Sunday.

itineraries.title: 3 nights - the literal preferred window (15-18 Feb 2027)

days.plan: Arrive, check in, and keep the evening light. OPM lists this as Washington's Birthday; no demand effect is assumed.
MoMA and, if time/energy allow, Top of the Rock. Both are near the hotel by the modelled distance estimate; routes have not been measured.
American Museum of Natural History and Central Park. The Met is closed Wednesdays.
Check out and travel to JFK. The preferred 15-18 Feb window is three hotel nights, not four.

itineraries.note: 15-18 Feb spans four calendar dates but only three hotel nights (nights of 15, 16, and 17 Feb). This short option prioritizes Midtown and the Upper West Side; the 7-night plan is needed for the other anchors.

itineraries.title: 14 nights - upper end of the brief (15 Feb - 1 Mar 2027)

days.plan: Outer-borough stars (Aska and Francie in Brooklyn, Meju in Queens), a day trip, and a second starred dinner. A separate seven-night Fairfield snapshot for this week is listed on the Hotels page; it is not a combined 14-night checkout quote (Q-13).

itineraries.note: A separate Fairfield 22 Feb-1 Mar seven-night snapshot is recorded, but this is not a combined 14-night checkout quote. Verify the actual room, fees, and availability before treating it as a two-week budget.

flags.title: The MICHELIN 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is 14 December 2026, before the trip
flags.detail: MICHELIN Media announced on 2026-08-11 that the Northeast Cities ceremony, including New York, will take place on the evening of 2026-12-14 at The Glasshouse. The roster on this site is the 2025 ceremony list and can change before the Feb 2027 trip.
flags.settle_by: After 2026-12-14, compare the newly published official New York selection with the 2025 roster and refresh the star table.

flags.title: The 2025 ceremony roster and current star filters have different totals
flags.detail: The 2025 ceremony article lists 72 entries (5 / 15 / 52); MICHELIN's current official star filters, read 2026-11-26, show 69 (5 / 14 / 50). These are differently dated official views, not yet reconciled name by name; the 2026 ceremony is still ahead.
flags.settle_by: Compare all three official star-filter result sets with the 2025 ceremony article, record additions/removals by date, then recheck after the 2026 ceremony.

flags.title: Hotel prices are live snapshots; some offers are promotional
flags.detail: All seven property-specific Booking.com room pages were re-read on 2026-11-26 for 15-22 Feb 2027. Rates can change; several show promotional discounts, and multiple properties display different refundable and non-refundable offers.
flags.settle_by: Recheck the same dated room URL and the cancellation/fee breakdown at the time of booking.

flags.title: Booking.com fixed nightly charges conflict with the statutory NYC/NYS components
flags.detail: Booking.com shows a $4 City tax per night for six hotels and $6/night for Residence Inn FiDi. NYC Finance lists a $2/night fixed hotel-occupancy tax for rooms at $40+, and NYS lists a separate $1.50/night NYC unit fee: $3.50/night combined. Both derived calculations are shown; their difference remains unresolved and neither is a checkout quote.
flags.settle_by: Compare the final property/Booking.com checkout breakdown with the itemized legal taxes and fees; ask the property what the $4/$6 line includes.

flags.title: The one-hour MICHELIN rule is modelled, not measured
flags.detail: Displayed hotel/activity times are simple straight-line/speed models, not MTA-scheduled door-to-door journeys. No complete route matrix was measured in the official MTA planner; the router reads attempted in this audit did not return a usable itinerary. Crossing the East River, access, transfers, and service disruptions can change actual times.
flags.settle_by: Measure each relevant hotel-to-restaurant/activity pair using the official MTA trip-planning tools for a stated departure time; record route, query date, and door-to-door time.

flags.title: Most restaurant menu prices could not be read
flags.detail: Only Le Bernardin, Gabriel Kreuther and Per Se published a readable price. Eleven Madison Park, Jungsik, Sushi Sho, Daniel and Gramercy Tavern either publish no price, hide it behind a booking flow, or serve their menu as an image.
flags.settle_by: Open each venue's Resy/Tock booking page, where the tasting-menu price is displayed before payment

flags.title: TikTok could not be verified at all
flags.detail: Every TikTok URL returned HTTP 400 to an automated read on 2026-11-25. No TikTok handle is asserted anywhere on this site; where TikTok appears it is a search link, labelled as a search.
flags.settle_by: Open the venue's own website and look for a TikTok icon, or search TikTok manually

flags.title: One Instagram handle was inferred, not opened
flags.detail: The Chelsea Market handle @chelseamarketny was read in a post by the verified High Line account, not by opening the Chelsea Market profile itself. It is labelled as unconfirmed.
flags.settle_by: Open https://www.instagram.com/chelseamarketny/ directly

flags.title: Standard hours for The Met and The High Line are verified; future exceptions remain possible
flags.detail: The Met currently lists Sun-Tue and Thu 10:00-17:00, Fri-Sat 10:00-21:00, closed Wednesday, with named holiday closures. The High Line visitor page lists Dec 1-Mar 31 07:00-20:00 and Apr 1-Nov 30 07:00-22:00; the 30th-34th Street Rail Yard Preserve closes at dusk.
flags.settle_by: Standard schedules resolved; recheck each official visit page for temporary/date-specific changes shortly before travel.

flags.title: Restaurant hours conflict between MICHELIN and the restaurant
flags.detail: Gramercy Tavern's MICHELIN listing shows dinner ending at 21:00, while the restaurant's own Instagram says the Tavern is open until 23:00 seven days a week. Both are official; they describe different rooms. The row is flagged rather than resolved.
flags.settle_by: Check gramercytavern.com hours for each room separately

flags.title: Federal holiday date confirmed by OPM
flags.detail: OPM's 2027 schedule lists Monday, 2027-02-15 as Washington's Birthday. The name/date is now officially sourced; no hotel-demand or price effect is inferred.
flags.settle_by: Resolved for the holiday date; verify hotel/attraction demand separately if it matters.

flags.title: A second-week Fairfield snapshot exists, but an exact 14-night checkout quote does not
flags.detail: The Fairfield King Room was displayed at $1,020.60 before taxes for 22 Feb-1 Mar 2027 (rechecked 2026-11-26). Booking-line arithmetic estimates $1,199.14; the official fixed-fee components yield $1,195.64. A live 14-night booking and other hotel rates remain unconfirmed.
flags.settle_by: Run the complete 15 Feb-1 Mar dated search and compare its final total/terms with the sum of two current 7-night quotes.

flags.title: Six hotel reach coordinates remain area-level approximations
flags.detail: Property-specific Booking.com pages now provide street addresses for all seven hotels (read 2026-11-26). Six hotel coordinates remain area-level rather than re-geocoded from those exact addresses, so straight-line reach counts may shift.
flags.settle_by: Capture a defensible coordinate source for each exact building, then recompute the proximity counts; this still does not supply measured transit times.

flags.title: An accessible Arlo SoHo room is the lowest displayed offer; Hyatt standard and accessible rates tie
flags.detail: The selected Arlo SoHo offer is labelled Courtyard Queen - ADA at $1,087 before taxes; its free-cancellation alternative was $1,632. At Hyatt Place Chelsea, both a standard King Room and an accessible king showed $1,113 in the 2026-11-26 snapshot.
flags.settle_by: Recheck room-specific prices and accessibility details before booking; no standard Arlo SoHo comparison rate was verified.

flags.title: The flight price is a fare, not a booking
flags.detail: The AMS-JFK fare snapshot for the itinerary dates 15-22 Feb 2027 was $606 per adult round trip on Aer Lingus with one stop; $562 required a 6h20m layover; nonstop KLM/Delta was $904-$906. Google Flights prices one traveller, so two seats may not cost exactly double and the fare is not a booking.
flags.settle_by: Price the same dates for 2 adults on the airline's own site

flags.title: One venue's hours exist in MICHELIN's data but not as text
flags.detail: Le Bernardin's Friday closing time is 23:00 and Saturday opens at 17:00; both were read from the structured hours block. Jungsik has no hours block at all on its MICHELIN page.
flags.settle_by: Read jungsik.com reservations page

flags.title: Hotel taxes and excluded fees matter; Fairfield leads both before and after current fee calculations
flags.detail: All seven Booking.com room totals on 2026-11-26 exclude taxes and fixed fees. Fairfield is currently the lowest base room rate ($985.60); it remains lowest using Booking.com's displayed fee line ($1,158.98) or the $3.50/night statutory fixed-charge calculation ($1,155.48). The comparison uses derived estimates, not checkout totals; Booking.com's fixed-fee labels still differ from the official statutory components (F-04).
flags.settle_by: Use the final dated checkout breakdown; recheck the fee labels and room type before booking.

flags.title: A 'star cluster' cannot be demonstrated from this dataset
flags.detail: Coordinates were verified for only 7 of the 72 star entries. Among those 7, only Eleven Madison Park and Gramercy Tavern sit within a kilometre of another scored venue (353 m). The others are each more than 1 km from the next one, so Manhattan star dining is dispersed rather than clustered. Any neighbourhood-level cluster map would be invented.
flags.settle_by: Verify coordinates for all 72 entries and compute density

flags.title: The hotel reach ranking covers 7 restaurants, not 72
flags.detail: The hotel page shows a 5 km straight-line proximity proxy for the seven restaurants with captured coordinates, not a ranking by measured one-hour transit. Sixty-five roster entries lack coordinates and no complete MTA journey matrix has been measured; the table must not be interpreted as one-hour reach.
flags.settle_by: Capture coordinates for all relevant venues and measure hotel-to-restaurant MTA itineraries before claiming an hour-based ranking.

flags.title: Statue of Liberty cannot be shown to meet the one-hour rule; ferry routing is unmeasured
flags.detail: The prior 56-minute figure came from a straight-line speed formula applied to Liberty Island as though it were a land-transit destination. It is not an MTA route and excludes the authorized ferry, boarding and waiting. The Feb 2027 sailing schedule was not published in the schedule read on 2026-11-26; the activity is no longer marked within one hour.
flags.settle_by: When Feb 2027 sailings are published, measure hotel-to-Battery-Park by MTA plus ferry crossing/boarding/wait, and report the total separately.

flags.title: All seven hotels link to dated, property-specific Booking.com pages
flags.detail: All seven source_url values now open the named property with 15-22 Feb 2027 dates, two adults, and USD selected. The three formerly generic search links were replaced with property-specific pages on 2026-11-26.
flags.settle_by: Closed 2026-11-26; keep the dated property-page URL beside every rate.

suggestions.title: Make this dashboard the single canonical site and retire the duplicate dataset
suggestions.problem: Two independently researched datasets are published side by side and disagree on the star count (72 vs 69), the hotel shortlist and the transit method. A reader cannot tell which to trust.
suggestions.proposal: Keep this dashboard as the canonical dataset, move the older deep dive to an 'archive' page with a one-line explanation, and delete the cross-links that present them as equal.
suggestions.risk: Low - nothing is deleted that is not first archived

suggestions.title: Replace modelled travel times with measured ones
suggestions.problem: The one-hour rule is the brief's central constraint, but the hotel table currently uses a 5 km straight-line radius and activity times are simple speed models; neither is a measured route.
suggestions.proposal: Batch-query an MTA-scheduled journey planner for all 7 hotels x the star restaurants that matter, cache the JSON, and show the measured door-to-door minutes with the query time and date. Keep the model only as a fallback, clearly labelled.

suggestions.title: Add a price-watch column with a re-check date
suggestions.problem: Hotel prices were re-read on 2026-11-26 and remain live snapshots; alternative Fairfield date windows show substantial movement.
suggestions.proposal: Keep the price checked date, dated source URL, and a re-check-by field for each hotel/window so changes can be compared rather than remembered.

suggestions.title: Finish the menu-price matrix from booking platforms
suggestions.problem: Five of the eight priority restaurants have no price, which makes the dinner plan impossible to budget.
suggestions.proposal: Open each venue's Resy or Tock page, where the tasting-menu price is shown before payment, and record it with the URL and the date. Where a venue only sells on the day, record that as the answer.

suggestions.title: Give every table a mobile card view, not just a scrolling table
suggestions.problem: The site already has a mobile card view, but long hotel and restaurant cards still make side-by-side comparison cumbersome on a small screen.
suggestions.proposal: Add an optional compact comparison view for selected hotels/restaurants that keeps the key facts, both hotel fee bases, and source links readable without horizontal scrolling.

suggestions.title: Add a printable one-page trip card
suggestions.problem: The site is a research document; on the day you need one page with addresses, hours and confirmation numbers.
suggestions.proposal: A print stylesheet plus a single page containing only confirmed bookings, with blank fields for confirmation numbers that the traveller fills in.

suggestions.title: Automate the link and data-integrity check
suggestions.problem: Manual checking does not scale past a few dozen rows and silently rots.
suggestions.proposal: A script run on every commit that (a) checks every internal link resolves, (b) checks every external URL returns 200, (c) fails the build if a table row has no source, and (d) fails if any numeric cell is non-numeric.
suggestions.risk: Low - external checks can be flaky, so warn rather than fail on those

suggestions.title: Separate 'starred' from 'guide-listed' into two visually distinct badges
suggestions.problem: A reader can mistake a Bib Gourmand or a plain listing for a star.
suggestions.proposal: Use one badge per distinction - three-star, two-star, one-star, Green Star, Bib Gourmand, Selected - with the badge drawn from MICHELIN's own icons and a legend at the top of the table.

suggestions.title: Reconcile the hotel fee lines before claiming a payable total
suggestions.problem: All seven selected Booking.com room rates exclude taxes/fees, and the displayed $4/$6 fixed lines differ from the $3.50 statutory components. A single derived figure could be mistaken for a final checkout amount.
suggestions.proposal: Ask the property or Booking.com what the fixed line includes, then store a dated final checkout breakdown if available. Until reconciled, keep the Booking-line estimate and statutory-component calculation side by side and label both as derived, not quotes.
suggestions.risk: Medium - the tax treatment differs by property and must be read per room, not assumed

suggestions.title: Add a February-specific weather and packing section
suggestions.problem: February in New York is cold and the itinerary includes outdoor walks; nothing on the site warns about it.
suggestions.proposal: Add a small panel with historical February temperature ranges from an official climate source and a packing list tied to the outdoor activities actually planned.

suggestions.title: Replace social search links with verified posts wherever an account is confirmed
suggestions.problem: Most social cells are search links, which is honest but not what the brief asked for.
suggestions.proposal: Where an official account is verified, link two or three specific posts (the profile page exposes recent post URLs) instead of the profile. Where no account exists, keep the labelled search link.
suggestions.risk: Low - post URLs can be deleted by the venue

suggestions.title: Add a booking countdown and deadline tracker
suggestions.problem: Reservation release windows differ by venue; a blanket 30-day countdown can mislead and may cause a missed opening date.
suggestions.proposal: For each selected restaurant, record its official booking platform's release rule and the date reservations for the chosen stay become available; keep the date blank until the venue publishes it.
suggestions.risk: None - the 30-day rule is a common pattern, so verify each venue's own window before relying on it
